Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Karl Malone?

Karl Malone is 62 years old.

Where was Karl Malone born?

Karl Malone was born in Summerfield, Louisiana.

When was Karl Malone born?

Karl Malone was born on July 24, 1963.

How tall is Karl Malone?

Karl Malone is 6-9 (206 cm) tall.

How much did Karl Malone weigh when playing?

Karl Malone weighed 250 lbs (113 kg) when playing.

Is Karl Malone in the Hall of Fame?

Karl Malone was inducted to the Hall of Fame as a Player in 2010 (Full List) .

When was Karl Malone drafted?

Karl Malone was drafted by Utah Jazz, 1st round (13th pick, 13th overall), 1985 NBA Draft.

What position did Karl Malone play?

Power Forward.

When did Karl Malone retire?

Karl Malone last played in 2004.

What is Karl Malone's net worth?

Karl Malone made at least $105,933,378 playing professional basketball.

How much did Karl Malone make?

Karl Malone made $19,250,000 in 2003.

What did Karl Malone average?

Karl Malone averaged 25.0 points, 10.1 rebounds, and 3.6 assists per game.

How many rings does Karl Malone have?

Karl Malone won 0 championships.

What schools did Karl Malone attend?

Karl Malone attended Summerfield in Summerfield, Louisiana and Louisiana Tech.

What are Karl Malone's nicknames?

The Mailman, King Karl are nicknames for Karl Malone.
